title: Reasons to stay natural: PEDs will make you stupid
summary: NH argues steroids are an 'X factor' so potent they crowd out every other training variable, so enhanced lifters stop learning programming and give useless advice to naturals. Naturals rely on the 'Y factor' of programming knowledge, which keeps evolving, can be taught to others, and stays with you even after losing muscle.
claims: Building a physique means juggling diet, training and recovery at once and constantly refining your knowledge
Steroids are an X factor: they build so much mass that they naturally become the priority and push out every other aspect of training
He will never take steroids partly because his time and effort already go into programming, diet and recovery, and there is no room for an X factor
Many pro bodybuilders with great physiques have zero programming knowledge and never discuss volume, intensity or frequency
Enhanced lifters become amateur chemists, studying drugs instead of training, so their advice fails naturals; they are ignorant rather than malicious
Most people who are really sharp on programming on YouTube are naturals, because they lack the X factor
On drugs you stop learning because you can just raise the dose, so you stop evolving as a lifter
Programming knowledge (the Y factor) can be passed on to others, while drug-built gains cannot be transmitted
Taking drugs is not graduating from natural training; it means you could not keep progressing naturally and fled
If a natural loses muscle, the knowledge remains and can help the next generation of natural lifters
